decision.reason: [ev-7b73f24193c6] is only a one-line commit title saying a UI null-reference bug in the parameter tab "w/ hydrator" was fixed. It doesn't name the configuration subject or describe the behaviour before and after the fix. It also doesn't say when the error happened, for example whether the source hydrator had to be enabled or an Application had to use a hydrator source. The only pointers to that detail are PRs #22097 and #22131, which aren't in the evidence. The PR descriptions or code diff are needed to decide subject, change and applicability.
